all-open.say: Two FemmeCare orders, start to finish. First a retail outlet, then a consultant.

uc1-open.say: Cool Planet orders for its Kandy showroom, but one product is out of stock.

uc1-01.say: Ruwan, in outlet sales, signs in with his work email.

uc1-02.say: A one-time code, so no shared passwords.

uc1-03.say: Today's work, all on one page.

uc1-04.say: Cool Planet's paper PO goes in as a new order, delivered to their Kandy showroom.

uc1-05.say: He keys in the three products from the PO. The system checks the stock on every line as he goes, so he knows what can go today before he saves.

uc1-06.say: Night pads are out, so those sixty packs join the queue, sixth in line.

uc1-07.say: Two hundred packs are set aside, just for them.

uc1-08.say: Kasun, in Stores, has new stock to receive.

uc1-09.say: The Night pads the outlets are waiting for.

uc1-10.say: He checks it against the delivery docket.

uc1-12.say: He can see who has waited longest, so they're served first.

uc1-13.say: Outlet sales are told at once.

uc1-14.say: Back to Ruwan. Six orders are waiting.

uc1-16.say: He checks each outlet still wants them, and every click sets the packs aside.

uc1-20.say: He makes the pick list for Cool Planet's order.

uc1-21.say: Each line takes the batch that expires soonest.

uc1-22.say: Every pack is scanned as it goes in the box.

uc1-24.say: The wrong product is stopped before it leaves.

uc1-25.say: He scans the rest. Each line counts up as he goes, until every pack on the order is in the box.

uc1-27.say: Ruwan issues the invoice and the delivery note in one go.

uc1-28.say: Cool Planet gets them by email, and the driver gets prints.

uc1-29.say: The invoice quotes their own PO number, so their accounts team can match it. It's due in forty five days.

uc1-30.say: The delivery note shows no prices, just the goods and a place to sign.

uc1-31.say: Kasun records the van and the driver, and the order goes out for delivery.

uc1-32.say: Now it waits for a signature.

uc1-33.say: The driver brings the signed note back.

uc1-36.say: Every figure is highlighted, so he can check it at a glance.

uc1-37.say: He adds who signed, and confirms.

uc1-38.say: Every pack is accounted for, and the order is complete.

uc1-40.say: Finally, Kasun checks the stock in the warehouse.

uc1-41.say: The new Night pads batch, and what's still promised to other outlets.

uc1-42.say: Each batch has its own page.

uc1-43.say: Showing where every pack went, ready for a recall.

uc1-close.say: From paper PO to signed note, with every pack traced.

uc2-open.say: Nimali Perayra, a consultant, orders on her phone and pays by card.

uc2-01.say: Nimali signs in on her phone with her consultant number and password.

uc2-02.say: Her home page shows how she and her team are doing this month.

uc2-03.say: She's already met her target, so her team's sales earn her five percent.

uc2-04.say: Each pack shows what she makes.

uc2-05.say: She picks what her customers want: ten Regular pads and four Night pads.

uc2-06.say: Just over ten thousand rupees, plus delivery.

uc2-07.say: She'll pay by card, and sees her margin first.

uc2-08.say: She enters her card on a secure FemmeCare payment page, just as she would in any online shop.

uc2-09.say: Paid, and straight to the warehouse.

uc2-10.say: In Operations, Malsha Goonasaykara has paid orders to pack.

uc2-11.say: Nimali's order is the newest on the board.

uc2-13.say: She scans an inner box of ten, then the four Night pads, one by one. The system counts every pack.

uc2-14.say: With everything checked, she hands it to the courier and adds the tracking number.

uc2-15.say: Nimali gets a text straight away.

uc2-16.say: Back on Nimali's phone, the text tells her who's bringing it, and how to track it.

uc2-17.say: Her order shows it's paid and on its way.

uc2-18.say: She can follow the parcel without calling anyone.

uc2-19.say: When it arrives, she confirms with one tap.

uc2-20.say: Paid and delivered, and nothing is left open to chase.

uc2-21.say: It now counts towards her own sales.

uc2-close.say: From her phone to her door, with every step on record.
